title: 第15章 罗云城城主府第16章 蛇王谷
slug: 无限吞噬你们求我晋级慢一点
content_zh:
青妖狼王此时朝江尘怒吼一声，然后它们看到江尘身后的其他青妖狼的尸体，也能知晓是江尘杀了它们的同伴了，对着江尘怒视。
“小兄弟，多谢你出手相助。”
南枫脱险了，马上来到江尘的身边。
他想不到江尘只是武者境五重，居然对三阶的青妖狼王出手，真有胆色。
“嗯，我们二人联手对付这两头青妖狼王如何？”
江尘道。
“好。”
南枫点点头，江尘能在这么短的时间内杀死这么多的二阶青妖狼，说明江尘的实力十分强大，不是一般的武者境五重。
江尘此时运转功法，将身后的青妖狼尸体内的血气之力吸收，江尘的气息一下子暴涨，迈入武者境六重。
先前江尘杀死了不少的妖兽了，加上几个佣兵，吞噬了大量的灵力，现在再吞噬这些青妖狼体内的灵力，所以再次晋级了。
南枫与唐沐都闪过诧异之色，想不到江尘居然如此轻易就突破了。
要知道一般修炼者想突破，都是要找一个安全的环境，然后再冲击新境界的，哪像江尘这样的？直接接就突破了。
不过江尘修为提升了，说明实力更强了。
“拔刀斩。”
江尘觉得这两头青妖狼王有点棘手，毕竟这是江尘第一次正式跟三阶妖兽交手。
之前江尘能杀死三阶巅峰的黑云鹰，那只是他运气好，遇到一个重伤的黑云鹰，出其不意，才杀死它的。
两头青妖狼王怒吼，分别向南枫还有江尘冲去，一人对付一头。
“拔刀斩，秘术灭天一击。”
江尘动用拔刀斩时，还动用了秘术灭天一击，只见江尘手中的长刀马上散发出金色的光芒。
江尘已经蓄力了，三阶二重的青妖狼王向着江尘扑过来，张开血盆大口，想将江尘给咬死。

一道惊人的刀气从江尘的长刀激发出来，直接杀向三阶二重的青妖狼王。
“噗……”
青妖狼王被这强大的刀气直接斩成两截，残尸从半空中掉落下来。
本来拔刀斩就能发挥出本人五倍的威力了，加上灭天一击的十倍加成，那么就是本身的五十倍威力了。
如此惊人的威力加成，这青妖狼王肯定不是对手了，直接被斩杀。
不远处的唐沐也是惊呆了，这个江尘的实力这么强大？
一击就斩杀了三阶的青妖狼王，要知道这青妖狼王可是将他们这些人逼入绝境的啊。
此时南枫正在跟另一头青妖狼王大战，没有第一时间关注江尘这边，现在战斗，不能分心啊。
“吞噬。”
江尘马上吞噬眼前变成两截尸体的青妖狼王的灵气，修为提升了一些，不过还无法突破武者境七重，越到后面，所需要的灵气就越多。
“嗖嗖……”
箭支直接射向另一头青妖狼王，青妖狼王没有反应过来，直接被射中了，身上中了三箭。
“冥斩。”
南枫看到好机会，于是直接动用武技，一记冥斩击在青妖狼王的身上，在其身上斩出一个大大的伤口。
就在这时，江尘的攻击也到了，一道刀光闪过，直接将眼前的青妖狼王给封喉了。
鲜血飞溅，最后一头青妖狼王不甘地倒在地上。
看到眼前的青妖狼王身死，南枫也是松了一口气，本来这一次他以为凶多吉少了，想不到江尘出手，让他们反败为胜。
南枫转过身，看到江尘身后另一头的青妖狼王的残尸也是一惊，这是江尘出手杀死的。
“这个少年好强大的实力，才武者境六重，居然能这么短时间内斩杀一头三阶的青妖狼王。”
南枫心里想道。

现在南枫可不敢小瞧江尘了，即使江尘的境界不如他，但是实力却有可能比他更强。
“我叫南枫，不知道小兄弟怎么称呼。”
南枫对江尘抱拳道。
content_en:
The Green Demon Wolf King roared at Jiang Chen at this time, and then when they saw the corpses of the other Green Demon Wolf behind Jiang Chen, they knew that Jiang Chen had killed their companions, and glared at Jiang Chen.
"Little brother, thank you for your help."
Nan Feng was out of danger and immediately came to Jiang Chen's side.
He didn't expect that Jiang Chen, who was only at the fifth level of the warrior realm, would actually attack the third level Green Demon Wolf King. He was really brave.
"Well, how about the two of us working together to deal with these two green demon wolf kings?"
Jiang Chen said.
"Okay."
Nan Feng nodded. Jiang Chen was able to kill so many second-level green demon wolves in such a short period of time, which showed that Jiang Chen was very powerful and not an ordinary fifth-level warrior.
Jiang Chen was running his skills at this time, absorbing the power of blood from the body of the green demon wolf behind him. Jiang Chen's aura suddenly surged, and he entered the sixth level of the warrior realm.
Jiang Chen had killed a lot of monsters before, plus a few mercenaries, and devoured a lot of spiritual power. Now he had devoured the spiritual power in these green demon wolves, so he was promoted again.
Nan Feng and Tang Mu both had expressions of surprise, they didn't expect Jiang Chen to break through so easily.
You must know that most cultivators who want to break through have to find a safe environment and then hit a new realm. How can they be like Jiang Chen? I broke through directly.
However, Jiang Chen's cultivation level has improved, which means that he is stronger.
"Draw your sword and chop."
Jiang Chen felt that these two green demon wolf kings were a bit tricky. After all, this was Jiang Chen's first official fight with a third-level demonic beast.
Jiang Chen was able to kill the Black Cloud Eagle at the peak of the third level before. It was only because he was lucky and encountered a seriously injured Black Cloud Eagle and caught it by surprise, so he killed it.
The two green demon wolf kings roared and rushed towards Nan Feng and Jiang Chen respectively, one against each.
"Draw your sword and strike with a secret technique that will destroy the sky."
When Jiang Chen used the sword to strike, he also used the secret technique of destroying the sky. The long sword in Jiang Chen's hand immediately emitted a golden light.
Jiang Chen had already accumulated strength, and the third-level and second-level Green Demon Wolf King rushed towards Jiang Chen, opening its bloody mouth, trying to bite Jiang Chen to death.
An astonishing sword energy was inspired from Jiang Chen's long sword, and it directly attacked the third-level and second-level Green Demon Wolf King.
"Pfft..."
The Green Demon Wolf King was directly cut into two pieces by this powerful sword energy, and his corpse fell from mid-air.
Originally, drawing the sword can bring out five times the power of oneself, and with the tenfold bonus of the sky-destroying strike, it becomes fifty times the power of oneself.
With such an astonishing increase in power, the Green Demon Wolf King was definitely no match and was killed directly.
Tang Mu, who was not far away, was also shocked. Is this Jiang Chen so powerful?
He killed the third-level Green Demon Wolf King with one blow. You must know that this Green Demon Wolf King forced them all into a desperate situation.
At this time, Nan Feng was fighting another green demon wolf king and did not pay attention to Jiang Chen's side immediately. He could not be distracted while fighting now.
"Swallow."
Jiang Chen immediately devoured the spiritual energy of the Green Demon Wolf King who turned into two corpses in front of him. His cultivation improved a bit, but he was still unable to break through to the seventh level of the warrior realm. The further he went, the more spiritual energy he needed.
"Whoosh..."
The arrow shot directly at the other Green Demon Wolf King. The Green Demon Wolf King did not react and was shot directly. He was hit by three arrows.
"Ming Zhan."
Nan Feng saw a good opportunity, so he directly used his martial arts and struck the Green Demon Wolf King with a dark slash, causing a big wound on his body.
At this moment, Jiang Chen's attack also arrived, and a sword flashed past, directly suffocating the Green Demon Wolf King in front of him.
Blood splattered, and the last green demon wolf king fell to the ground unwillingly.
Seeing the death of the Green Demon Wolf King in front of him, Nan Feng also breathed a sigh of relief. Originally, he thought that this time there was less danger, but he didn't expect Jiang Chen to take action and turn defeat into victory.
Nan Feng turned around and was shocked to see the corpse of the Green Demon Wolf King on the other side behind Jiang Chen. Jiang Chen had killed it.
"This boy is so powerfulWith such strength, he was only at the sixth level of the warrior realm, and he could actually kill a third-level green demon wolf king in such a short time. "
Nan Feng thought to himself.
Now Nan Feng doesn't dare to underestimate Jiang Chen. Even if Jiang Chen's level is not as good as his, his strength may be stronger than his.
"My name is Nan Feng, I don't know what to call my little brother. "
Nan Feng cupped his fist and said to Jiang Chen.
